# Step - to_mermaid

`to_mermaid` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and renders its results in Mermaid format (a schema map as a diagram; other results as JSON per line).

## Forms

```text
to_mermaid()
to_mermaid(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").to_mermaid()   // "marko"
```

## See also

- [Displaying Results](../../users_guide/displaying_results.md)
